universe: B5 KEYSTONE pools whose signal_time falls in 2026-02-27T05:41:15Z..2026-06-08T18:29:40Z; execution and adverse policy exactly B5
signal_time: KEYSTONE t0; every weather input uses timestamps strictly before t0

issuance_ratio.definition: count of Base WETH pools created in trailing 7d divided by 7, over count in preceding 28d divided by 28

honeypot_proxy.definition: among B4 fresh V3 probes created in trailing 7d and observable >=2m before signal, share with QuoterV2 sell recovery <10% of 0.001 WETH; absent/Atomic-unknown proxy rows count adverse

eth_trend.definition: return from UTC daily close D-8 to D-1; current signal day close forbidden

gate_rule: OPEN iff issuance_ratio<=1.25 AND honeypot_proxy_rate<=0.20 AND honeypot_proxy_n>=20 AND eth_trailing_7d_return>=-0.05; otherwise CLOSED

chronology.calibration: before 2026-04-15T00:00:00Z; thresholds remain the fixed values above

random_gate.method: sample calendar open-days without replacement from eligible days, preserving exactly the true gate open-day count; apply the same sampled days to all opportunities
random_gate.comparison: true gated mean must be strictly above random mean 95th percentile

cost_and_missing.execution: B5 decoded real swap limit-fill model

capacity: report absolute selected opportunities, open calendar days, opportunities per open day, total 0.001-WETH notional and maximum one-day notional
decision: all pass_gates true => PASS; any false => FAIL; never a GO decision
